sources.entry: Modoboa - Mail hosting and management platform including a modern and simplified web user interface. (Source Code) ISC Python

summary.one_liner: Modoboa is a mail hosting and management platform with a web interface for administering mail domains and accounts, plus a built-in webmail.
summary.what_it_does: Modoboa provides an administration panel for managing mail domains and users, and a webmail client. It integrates with Postfix and Dovecot and uses a central SQL database (MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL or SQLite) as the shared point of communication between components. Reputation protection features include DNSBL checks and DMARC reports. It also includes an Amavis frontend, a calendar, an address book, per-user Sieve filters, autoreply messages, and graphical email traffic statistics. The project is modular, and all current features are described as extensions. It is written in Python 3 using Django and Vue.
use_cases: manage mail accounts and domains through a web panel
check DMARC reports and DNS blocklists
how_to_run: Use the official installer (see the project documentation)
notable: Modular design where all current features are extensions
Built-in webmail, calendar and address book
Reputation protection with DNSBL and DMARC report checks
Uses a central SQL database shared by mail components
caveats: Advanced features and dedicated support are offered only in the paid Modoboa Pro edition
Professional services and support plans are offered by the team for a fee
README does not describe platform requirements beyond the installer
